system.description:
Blade Heart · cast at B-Rank to S-Rank · no type

As a Bonus action on your turn, or as a reaction to taking damage, you can assume your Parrying stance until the beginning of your next turn: +2 AC and Dexterity saving throws.

When you score a critical hit with your weapon with a weapon or Taijutsu attack, the target gains 1 rank of Bleed.

If you are disarmed, this jutsu ends.
